messages:
ravi: FYI onboarding failing in eu-west-2 warmpool, nodes stuck in 'waiting for keystore'. seeing `Decrypt -> 403` across many kubelets.

zoe: did any egress ACLs change in eu-west-2 this afternoon?

ben: I ran a repro from a test instance in the ephemeral subnet: `curl -v https://keystore-eu.internal/Decrypt` gets a TCP RST mid-handshake. can reproduce from two AZs.

auto-policy-bot: policy-rollout #infra-egress/2026-03-18 applied to eu-west-2 at 14:07 UTC by infra-deploy. Affected rule group: ephemeral-egress.

zoe: looks like the commit removed a legacy CIDR block but the maintainers accidentally excluded the NAT instance IP block that our NATGW-to-privatelink path uses. so traffic to privatelink IPs is being dropped.

claire: blast radius? onboarding only or also existing nodes?

ravi: existing nodes mostly fine (they have cached grants) but warmpool joins and scale-ups are failing. autoscaler queue is growing; fallback to other regions triggered some cold-start instances in us-west which will increase spend.

pager: alert: GPU eu-west-2 pool available capacity = 38% (SLO target 80%). Latency risk for dedicated customers.

claire: short-term mitigation: add explicit allow entries for the privatelink IPs and NAT /32s to the ephemeral ACL, mark change with expire tag, and reduce SIEM audit-sampling to avoid log storm. need infra + security signoff.

ben: prepping a minimal ACL patch now. tested locally against staging NATs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4332 (adds three /32s, expire=2026-03-18T16:00Z).

zoe: security: +1 if we limit to those exact /32s and add TTL. also enable shipper sampling throttle so our SIEM doesn't choke during the allow period.

auto-policy-bot: rollout started for PR#4332 at 14:22 UTC (canary -> 2 subnets).

ben: applied. monitoring for auth success and queued join reduction. plan 15min validate then extend to all subnets.

pager: metric: keystore decrypt 403 rate falling from 120/min to 5/min within 6m of change. queue length dropping.

ravi: for follow-up: add a pre-apply check in infra CI that compares ACL commit CIDRs vs current NAT inventory, block changes that could orphan NAT paths. also RFC to migrate keystore traffic fully to privatelink and gate ACL rollouts on NAT healthchecks. open an infra ticket for cost impact (cross-region cold starts + on-demand fallback).

claire: +1 on RFC. also require two approvers for egress changes that touch keystore/kms scopes.

pager: status: eu-west-2 GPU pool stabilizing, keeping incident open 1h post-stable. cost note: estimate extra on-demand hours = ~12h across regions -> finance notified. :white_check_mark:
